notes: The page continues and closes a typed letter. Its first line completes a question about groups of exterior automorphisms; no preceding-page content was consulted.
The long paragraph asks about the canonical Lie-algebra morphism, Steinberg's group morphism, ranks on unipotent orbits, and varieties of Borel subgroups containing an element.

The rank discussion is qualified by the exact phrases "There are some reasons to believe", "I would expect that there is just one orbit", and "maybe this property will be caracteristic". These are expectations, not proofs supplied here.

The dimension discussion says "I would expect the dimension of the previous variety to be equal to i" and then "the inequality ... would imply" rationality of the relevant singularities. No proof of the inequality or of the implication is given on the sheet.

The author asks for comments and closes "Sincerely yours" with a handwritten autograph at the lower right. There is no date, title heading, own page number, or total page count. The lower-left archival 22 is recorded only as a comment.

Source spellings analoguous and caracteristic, the order how varies, rang, and singular answer with are are retained. The crop of answer additionally exposes local overlapping contours, marked independently of grammar.
No mathematical plausibility was used to assign strike order to overlapping typewriter forms. The formal dimension substitution described under math_checks was the only computation performed.
The adjacent cover title originally appended to H was explicitly outside this page and is excluded from comparison, following the supplied packet boundary correction.
